Adolescent substance use in grades 8, 10 and 12 (simulated)

substance.Rd

Past-30-day use of alcohol, binge drinking, cigarettes and cannabis by 1,500 students at three waves, designed for latent transition analysis with categorical indicators (lta()).

Usage

substance

Format

A data frame with 1,500 rows and 15 columns:

id

Student id.

alc_1, alc_2, alc_3

Any alcohol in the past 30 days (0/1) in grades 8, 10, 12.

binge_1, binge_2, binge_3

Five or more drinks on one occasion in the past two weeks (0/1).

cig_1, cig_2, cig_3

Cigarettes in the past 30 days (0/1).

mj_1, mj_2, mj_3

Cannabis in the past 30 days (0/1).

female

1 = girl.

monitor

Parental monitoring (z-score).

Columns are ordered by wave (alc_1, binge_1, cig_1, mj_1, alc_2, ...). Attrition: 5 percent only grade 8, a further 7 percent grades 8 and 10 only.

Source

Simulated by datasets/generate.jl of LatentMixtures.jl (seed Xoshiro(20261105)); codebook in its datasets/README.md. Three latent statuses with P(use | status) for Non-use, Alcohol use and Polysubstance use: alcohol .05/.85/.92, binge .01/.35/.70, cigarettes .02/.12/.60, cannabis .01/.10/.65 (invariant over time). Grade-8 status depends on monitor and female. Transition matrices (rows: from Non-use, Alcohol, Poly): grade 8 to 10 [.70 .24 .06; .12 .68 .20; .03 .17 .80], grade 10 to 12 [.62 .30 .08; .08 .72 .20; .02 .18 .80]. Modelled on Collins & Lanza (2010), Latent Class and Latent Transition Analysis, Wiley. Licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain).

Examples

data(substance)
# prevalence of alcohol use rises from grade 8 to grade 12
colMeans(substance[, c("alc_1", "alc_2", "alc_3")], na.rm = TRUE)
#>     alc_1     alc_2     alc_3 
#> 0.2620000 0.4401408 0.5689394 
# \donttest{
# how do students move between substance-use statuses? (3 statuses)
t3 <- lta(substance, waves = list(alc_1:mj_1, alc_2:mj_2, alc_3:mj_3), K = 3)
#> Starting Julia ...
transitions(t3)[[1]]  # grade 8 -> 10: rows = from, columns = to
#>         to
#> from           class1    class2     class3
#>   class1 6.887848e-01 0.2436745 0.06754074
#>   class2 1.030446e-01 0.7269494 0.17000598
#>   class3 6.808015e-16 0.1686199 0.83138015
# }
